Rename, convert and reproject field points for modelling

Source: R/field_ingest.R
prepare_field_table.Rd

Produces the canonical field table every downstream function expects: sample_id (character) and biomass_kgha (numeric), in the raster CRS. All other attributes are preserved untouched.

Usage

prepare_field_table(
  points,
  id_col,
  biomass_col,
  units = c("kg/ha", "Mg/ha", "g/m^2", "unknown"),
  target_crs
)

Arguments

points

An sf POINT layer from read_field_points().

id_col

Column holding the sample identifier.

biomass_col

Column holding the biomass measurement.

units

Units of biomass_col: "kg/ha", "Mg/ha", "g/m^2" or "unknown" (passed through unchanged).

target_crs

CRS of the raster stack the samples will be extracted against.

Value

An sf POINT layer of class dronebio_field_points, carrying a dropped_na attribute with the number of rows removed for a missing biomass value.

Examples

path <- system.file("extdata", "field_samples.csv", package = "DroneBioR")
pts <- read_field_points(path, crs = 32617)
tab <- prepare_field_table(pts, "sample_id", "biomass_kgha",
                           units = "kg/ha", target_crs = "EPSG:32617")
names(tab)[1:2]
#> [1] "sample_id"    "biomass_kgha"
